verdict.rationale: Omarchy wires AI agents into the OS itself. On first boot it invites you to set up a default agent, and it ships OpenCode and Claude Code as default harnesses. Its own crash-notification flow sends that agent to examine the crash dump and diagnose the failure, which is a product-integrated case of AI insight from user data. Beyond crash diagnosis and agent-assisted configuration, the docs show no broader AI-generated insights or suggestions over user data, and the AI comes from third-party agents you must sign into. Missing for 10: insights and suggestions beyond crash dumps (e.g. over files, usage or system data), a first-party AI insights surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the crash-diagnosis flow.
